text: John visited Chicago, praising its energy and friendly locals. Tim recommends "The Name of the Wind" fantasy novel; John adds it to his list, loving strong characters and world-building. John's lucky basketball shoes symbolize resilience and determination. He started basketball as a kid watching NBA with his dad, signed up at age ten, earned a college scholarship, and was drafted. His top goal is winning a championship; he's teaming with a local organization helping disadvantaged kids with sports and school.
